title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Lamborghini Revuelto
description:
The Lamborghini Revuelto has one thousand and one horsepower, a V12 that revs past nine thousand r p m, and a price tag that can pass eight hundred thousand dollars with options. But the two most interesting things about this car are hidden where most people never look. One of them is sideways. The other one runs right between your seats. In this video we open up the Revuelto and show you two secrets that explain the whole car. Why Lamborghini turned its gearbox ninety degrees, and why the battery of a one-thousand-horsepower supercar is smaller than the battery of many small hybrids. And the second secret changes how the car behaves every time you start it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
